items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He said, Tax Daddy used to be a ranger, eh? Well, Tax Daddy. Adolph Alexander.

ctx.x: He said, Tax Daddy used to be a ranger, eh? Well, Tax Daddy. Adolph Alexander. Adolph Alexander. What do you say? Tax.
He plays clarinet, saxophone, and a baritone. Tell him.
